channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 13
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 13 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Block 13's new 93 ft and 133 ft limits do not apply yet
item.description: Block 13's new 93 ft and 133 ft limits do not apply yet. The block is in the PG&E Sub-Area, where the ordinance takes effect only after a Notice of Joinder to the Development Agreement is recorded or the land is conveyed to the Developer. We found no sign that either has happened. The same condition applied to the earlier 85 ft and 125 ft limits, so they have not been in force on this land either. The earlier note giving November 13, 2026 for Block 13 was wrong. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 52, 54, 56; BOS File 260724 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 2 and 10; SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (read 2026-10-18).
item.source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 52, 54, 56; BOS File 260724 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 2 and 10; SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (read 2026-10-18)

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 13: 93 ft and 133 ft. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (85 ft and 125 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.
item.source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: The Block 13 page now says that the Design for…
item.description: The Block 13 page now says that the Design for Development limits office to the basement, ground floor and mezzanine, and retail and entertainment to the basement, ground floor, mezzanine and second floor, as well as limiting PDR (production, distribution and repair) uses. Laboratory and life science uses are still not permitted. Source: https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf ; https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: The April 2020 Board approval covers the Design for…
item.description: The April 2020 Board approval covers the Design for Development that lists Block 13. The Planning Commission had already approved that document on January 30, 2020. item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Block 13's record and map notes no longer say the D4D…
item.description: Block 13's record and map notes no longer say the D4D shows 280 ft and 300 ft towers: on Figure 6.2.3 those labels are dimension lines, and the block's height limits are 85 ft and 125 ft, so the alleged inconsistency with the midrise text is removed. The block is now described as sitting in the 4.8-acre PG&E-owned northern switchyard area (SF Planning project page; D4D Figure 1.2.1), not vacant land, with build-out dependent on the switchyard's relocation; an addressed Assessor lot (4175499, 1101 Illinois St) overlaps the footprint but is not confirmed as that parcel. The 2035 completion is kept as a Phase 3 forecast from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Block 13 vertical development 2031-2035) instead of a whole-project target. Sources now point to the final D4D rather than a dead 2019 draft link, D4D publishers are shown as SF Planning, and one image is labelled a document, not a rendering. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn).
item.source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn)

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Completion expected: Block 13 is in Phase 3 of… (~2035)
item.description: Completion expected: Block 13 is in Phase 3 of the revised phasing, and SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists its vertical development 2031-2035 (it is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) (~2035). Source: SocketSite, 2020-10-09; SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SF Planning.

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 13; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning, 2020-02-26.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning, 2020-02-26
